name: nexolink-site
description: NexoLink landing page and admin dashboard.

scripts.build: npm --prefix "volunteer-dashboard (2)/nexolink-landing-page" run build && npm --prefix "volunteer-dashboard (2)/admin" run build && npm --prefix "volunteer-dashboard (2)/volunteer" run build && rm -rf "volunteer-dashboard (2)/nexolink-landing-page/dist/admin" && rm -rf "volunteer-dashboard (2)/nexolink-landing-page/dist/volunteer" && mkdir -p "volunteer-dashboard (2)/nexolink-landing-page/dist/admin" && mkdir -p "volunteer-dashboard (2)/nexolink-landing-page/dist/volunteer" && cp -R "volunteer-dashboard (2)/admin/dist/"* "volunteer-dashboard (2)/nexolink-landing-page/dist/admin/" && cp -R "volunteer-dashboard (2)/volunteer/dist/"* "volunteer-dashboard (2)/nexolink-landing-page/dist/volunteer/"
